title: 2018 Panini Prizm #45 Derek Carr Las Vegas Raiders Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2018 Panini Prizm trading card features Derek Carr, the former Oakland Raiders quarterback who is now playing for the Las Vegas Raiders. The card is part of the base set and is numbered 45 out of 45. It is an original, single-insert card that was manufactured by Panini America, Inc.

The card has a Prizm parallel/variety and comes with features that make it a great addition to any sports trading card collection. It is perfect for fans of the National Football League (NFL) and collectors who are looking for a unique item to add to their collection. This card is not autographed and is not considered vintage.
